summary: Reduce ISO and Core package transport overhead while preserving every driver, offline install capability, source archive and installed path. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Explain unchanged offline driver availability, checksum failures, artifact size reporting and verification evidence.

api.reason: Build and installer transport only; installed source-serving/media paths, Controller/Core requests, commands, authentication, results and adoption contracts remain unchanged.

roadmap.reason: Packaging efficiency changes no product feature scope or phase acceptance.
